title: Freshdesk Ticket Auto Responder
description: Classify new inbound Freshdesk tickets, return automation-ready routing metadata, and generate a customer-facing reply text.

type.description: Freshdesk-style ticket type classification. For auto-reply categories, use exact values: status -> 'Where is my order?', cancellation -> 'Cancellation', return -> 'Return'.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the classification based on explicit evidence.

tags_to_add.description: Tags to apply for automation routing. Empty when no auto-reply should be sent.

should_auto_reply.description: True only when the message is safe for auto-reply using one of the supported templates.

reply_text.description: Final customer-facing reply body. Required when should_auto_reply is true; null when should_auto_reply is false.

ticket_status_to_set.description: Freshdesk status to set after auto-reply. Null when no auto-reply should be sent.

do_not_auto_reply_reason.description: Short reason when should_auto_reply is false. Null when should_auto_reply is true.
